While our website is designed to work on mobile devices, our Android and iOS app provide a better mobile experience. Google Play App Store Events Earth Orbit Yesterday, 23:49 Artemis II Trans-Lunar Injection The Orion Integrity will perform the Trans-Lunar Injection burn with the Artemis II mission composed of NASA astronauts commander Reid Wiseman, pilot Victor Glover and mission specialist Christina Koch, and mission specialist Jeremy Hansen of Canada's CSA, setting the mission on course for a free-return trajectory around the Moon. Watch Moon Monday, 23:58 Artemis II Moon Closest Approach The Orion Integrity will make its closest approach to the Moon with the Artemis II mission composed of NASA astronauts commander Reid Wiseman, pilot Victor Glover and mission specialist Christina Koch, and mission specialist Jeremy Hansen of Canada's CSA, bringing it within 6,513 km of the lunar far side. Watch International Space Station April 10, 05:15 Cygnus (NG-24) Capture The Cygnus (NG-24) cargo resupply spacecraft will be captured by the robotic Canadarm2 on the International Space Station.
